To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new approach for information extraction that uses deep neural networks and is able to process web pages without any site specific initialization.

deep convolutional neural networks can be trained to extract information from web pages, that the spatial text encoding is able to represent the visual and the textual content of a page, and that the resulting wrapper does not need a site specific initialization and can be applied to a single web page.

(i) Deep neural networks can learn to extract structured information from a single webpage, (ii) Deep neural networks are able to learn a site-independent web wrapper, (iii) Deep neural networks for web wrapper can learn to extract information from previously seen and unseen templates.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a general web wrapper, which is able to extract structured information from web sites with previously unseen templates.
developing methods for web information extraction, which are able to extract information without the need to adapt the wrapper to a particular site.
the development of a web wrapper that can extract product information without any manual adaptation to the website structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work shows that deep learning methods have the potential to solve the web wrapper problem.
the proposed approach can extract information from web pages without any prior knowledge of the website template.
the presented approach has the potential to be a general web wrapper.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a deep neural network architecture for extracting information from a web page, which does not rely on a template specific initialization.
we are able to extract product information from a single product page without any site specific initialization.
this is the first time that deep learning is applied to extract information from web pages and the first time that a site-independent wrapper is presented.
The main takeaway from our work is that
deep neural networks can be used to learn a wrapper, which can extract information from a website without any site specific initialization.
convolutional neural networks can be used as general purpose web wrappers.
deep learning methods can be applied to extract structured information from web documents.
